t2.title: Families are spending less time together than they used to
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Families are spending less time together than they used to." Discuss the reasons and consequences of this trend, giving appropriate examples. Write 180-200 words.
t2.sample:
The Changing Dynamics of Family Time

It is increasingly common to hear that families spend less quality time together than in previous generations. This trend has several causes and significant consequences.

Firstly, demanding work schedules leave parents with little energy for family activities. Many people work long hours or multiple jobs to meet financial obligations. Additionally, technology has become a major distraction. Family members often sit in the same room yet remain absorbed in their own devices.

Furthermore, children's schedules are increasingly packed with extracurricular activities, leaving little time for shared meals or conversations.

The consequences are far-reaching. Reduced family time can weaken emotional bonds and lead to communication problems. Children may feel isolated or seek connection elsewhere, potentially through unhealthy relationships.

However, awareness of this issue is growing. Many families are now consciously scheduling device-free time and regular outings. By prioritizing connection over convenience, families can rebuild meaningful relationships.
t2.sampleA1:

The machines are new. Good. I like gym. Clean. Trainers ok. Bye.
t2.sampleA2:
Hello Fitness Club,


I liked the new machines, and they were easy to use. The trainers were helpful, and they answered my questions. But the gym was a little dirty. I think the music was too loud. Thank you.
t2.sampleB1:
Dear Fitness Club Team,


Thank you for asking for my feedback. I tried some of the new equipment today, and I think it is very good. It was easy to use, and I liked the variety of machines available.


The trainers were also helpful. They showed me how to use the equipment safely and answered my questions. In my opinion, they are doing a good job.


However, I think the cleanliness could be improved. There were some areas that needed attention. Also, the atmosphere was a little too noisy for me. Maybe you could turn the music down a little.


Overall, I had a good experience. Thank you for your efforts.


Sincerely,
A Member
t2.sampleB2: Hi everyone, This is such a great topic, and to be honest it hits close to home for me. I really do think families spend far less time together than they used to, and there are a few reasons behind it. For starters, everyone seems glued to a screen these days. My little brother would happily scroll through his phone all evening rather than chat over dinner. On top of that, parents are working longer hours just to make ends meet, so by the time they get home they are completely worn out. The consequences genuinely worry me. When families slowly drift apart, children can end up feeling lonely and turning to friends — or worse, the internet — for the support they should really be getting at home. Simple pleasures like Sunday lunch or a board game are quietly becoming a thing of the past. That said, I don't think it's all doom and gloom. At home we've introduced a 'no phones at dinner' rule, and it has genuinely brought us closer. What about the rest of you? Have you noticed the same thing? I'd love to hear your thoughts! Dilnoza
t2.uzSample:
Oila vaqtining o'zgaruvchan dinamikasi

Oila a'zolari avvalgi avlodlarga nisbatan kamroq sifatli vaqt o'tkazayotgani haqida eshitish tobora keng tarqalgan. Bu tendentsiyaning bir nechta sabablari va sezilarli oqibatlari mavjud.

Birinchidan, band ish jadvali ota-onalarda oilaviy tadbirlar uchun kam energiya qoldiradi. Ko'p odamlar moliyaviy majburiyatlarni bajarish uchun uzoq soatlar yoki bir nechta ishlarda ishlaydi. Bundan tashqari, texnologiya asosiy chalg'ituvchi omilga aylandi. Oila a'zolari ko'pincha bir xonada o'tirishadi, ammo o'z qurilmalariga berilib ketishadi.

Bundan tashqari, bolalarning jadvali tobora ko'proq darsdan tashqari mashg'ulotlar bilan to'lib bormoqda, bu esa umumiy ovqatlanish yoki suhbatlar uchun kam vaqt qoldiradi.

Oqibatlari keng qamrovli. Oila vaqtining qisqarishi hissiy aloqalarni zaiflashtirishi va kommunikatsiya muammolariga olib kelishi mumkin. Bolalar o'zini yakkalab qo'ygandek his qilishlari yoki boshqa joydan, ehtimol nosog'lom munosabatlar orqali aloqa izlashlari mumkin.

Biroq, bu muammoni anglash ortib bormoqda. Ko'p oilalar hozirda ongli ravishda qurilmasiz vaqt va muntazam sayohatlarni rejalashtirishmoqda. Qulaylikdan ko'ra aloqaga ustunlik berish orqali oilalar mazmunli munosabatlarni qayta tiklashlari mumkin.

Uskunalar yangi. Yaxshi. Menga sport zal yoqadi. Toza. Murabbiylar yaxshi. Xayr.
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom, Fitness Klub!


Menga yangi uskunalar yoqdi va ulardan foydalanish oson edi. Murabbiylar yordam berishdi va savollarimga javob berishdi. Lekin sport zal biroz iflos edi. Menimcha, musiqa juda baland edi. Rahmat.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli Fitness Klub Jamoasi,


Fikrimni so'raganingiz uchun rahmat. Men bugun yangi jihozlarning ba'zilarini sinab ko'rdim va menimcha, ular juda yaxshi. Ulardan foydalanish oson edi va menga mavjud mashinalarning xilma-xilligi yoqdi.


Murabbiylar ham yordam berishdi. Ular menga jihozlardan qanday qilib xavfsiz foydalanishni ko'rsatishdi va savollarimga javob berishdi. Mening fikrimcha, ular yaxshi ish qilishyapti.


Biroq, menimcha, tozalikni yaxshilash mumkin. E'tibor talab qiladigan ba'zi joylar bor edi. Shuningdek, atmosfera men uchun biroz shovqinli edi. Ehtimol, musiqani biroz pasaytirsangiz bo'lar.


Umuman olganda, men yaxshi tajribaga ega bo'ldim. Sa'y-harakatlaringiz uchun rahmat.


Hurmat bilan,
A'zo
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli Fitness Klub Jamoasi,


Yaqinda tashrifim haqida fikr bildirish imkoniyati uchun rahmat. Men, ayniqsa, yangi jihozlarni sinab ko'rishga qiziqdim va shuni aytishim kerakki, umuman olganda taassurot oldim. Uskunalar zamonaviy va tushunarli bo'lib, ularni fitnes darajalarining keng doirasi uchun qulay qiladi. Murabbiylar ham doimo tayyor edilar va to'g'ri foydalanish va texnika bo'yicha foydali maslahatlar berishdi. A'zolarning uskunadan xavfsiz va samarali foydalanishini ta'minlashdagi faol yondashuvlarini qadrlayman.


Biroq, takliflarim bor. Uskunaning o'zi juda yaxshi bo'lsa-da, men ayrim joylarning, ayniqsa og'irlik mashinalari atrofining tozaligi yaxshiroq saqlanishi kerakligini payqadim. Bundan tashqari, umumiy atmosfera, garchi energiya bilan to'lgan bo'lsa-da, ba'zan biroz tartibsiz tuyuldi. Ehtimol, tinch zonalarini tashkil etish yoki musiqa ovozini sozlash, diqqatni jamlagan holda mashq qilishni istaganlar uchun tajribani yaxshilashi mumkin.


Ushbu kichik muammolarga qaramay, men Fitness Klubning mamnun a'zosi bo'lib qolaman. O'ylaymanki, ushbu masalalarni hal qilish muassasaning umumiy sifatini yanada oshiradi va barcha a'zolar uchun yanada ijobiy tajribaga hissa qo'shadi.


Hurmat bilan,
Qadrli A'zo

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the fitness club. Write about your feelings and what you think the club management should do.
t12.sample:
Dear Fitness Club Team,

Thank you for reaching out for feedback. As a regular member, I am happy to share my thoughts.

Firstly, the new equipment is excellent. The machines are modern and easy to use, with clear instructions provided.

Additionally, your trainers are incredibly supportive. They patiently answer questions and provide personalized advice that helps me stay on track with my fitness goals.

However, I would suggest offering more evening classes, as many members work during the day. Furthermore, the changing rooms could benefit from more frequent cleaning during peak hours.

Overall, the atmosphere is motivating and the facilities are well-maintained. I thoroughly enjoy being a member.

Kind regards,
A Dedicated Member
t12.sampleA1:
Hi Fitness Club,


I like new bikes. Easy. Trainer is good. Gym is ok. Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Hi,


Thank you for email. I like the new machines, and they are easy. The trainer is nice and helps me. But the gym is not very clean, and sometimes it is too busy. I think you need more cleaning. Thank you.


Bye,


Bobur Qodirov
t12.sampleB1:
Dear Fitness Club Team,


Thank you for asking about my visit. I think the new equipment is good. It's easy to use, and I like the new treadmills. The trainers are also very helpful. They answered my questions and gave me good advice.


However, I think the gym could be cleaner. Sometimes the changing rooms are dirty. Also, it's very crowded in the evenings. Maybe you could have more classes at different times.


Overall, I am happy with the gym. Thank you.


Sincerely,
Bobur Qodirov
t12.sampleB2: Dear Fitness Club Team, Thank you for reaching out for feedback after my recent visit. On the whole, I was thoroughly impressed with what the club has to offer. To begin with, the new equipment is a real step up from the old machines. Everything is modern, intuitive and clearly labelled, which made my workout far more enjoyable. Your trainers deserve credit too; they were on hand throughout and gave me sound advice that kept me on track with my goals. That said, there is still room for improvement. The changing rooms could do with more frequent cleaning during peak hours, as they felt rather neglected. I would also encourage you to add more evening classes, since many of us work during the day. Overall, I remain a happy member and trust these suggestions will be taken on board. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Karimova
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli Fitness Klub Jamoasi,

Fikr-mulohazalar uchun murojaat qilganingiz uchun rahmat. Muntazam a'zo sifatida o'z fikrlarimni baham ko'rishdan mamnunman.

Avvalo, yangi uskunalar a'lo darajada. Uskunalar zamonaviy va ishlatish uchun qulay, aniq ko'rsatmalar bilan ta'minlangan.

Bundan tashqari, sizning murabbiylaringiz juda qo'llab-quvvatlovchi. Ular savollarga sabr bilan javob berishadi va menga fitnes maqsadlarimga erishishimga yordam beradigan shaxsiy maslahatlar berishadi.

Biroq, men ko'proq kechki mashg'ulotlar taklif qilishni tavsiya qilaman, chunki ko'pchilik a'zolar kunduzi ishlaydi. Bundan tashqari, kiyinish xonalari eng gavjum soatlarda tez-tez tozalanib turishidan foyda ko'rishi mumkin.

Umuman olganda, muhit motivatsiya beruvchi va jihozlar yaxshi saqlangan. Men a'zo bo'lishdan juda mamnunman.

Hurmat bilan,
Sizning sodiq a'zoingiz

Biroq, menimcha, sport zalini tozalash kerak. Ba'zan kiyim almashtirish xonalari iflos bo'ladi. Bundan tashqari, kechqurunlari juda gavjum bo'ladi. Balki siz turli vaqtlarda ko'proq mashg'ulotlar o'tkazishingiz mumkin.

Ushbu kichik tashvishlarga qaramay, men qoniqarli a'zo bo'lib qolaman va klubning ijobiy fitnes muhitini ta'minlashga sodiqligini qadrlayman.


Hurmat bilan,
Bobur Qodirov

tasks.p1_context: You received this email from your local fitness club.
tasks.p1_scenario:
Dear Member,

Thank you for visiting our club today! We want to make sure we are providing the best service possible.
How did you find our new equipment? Was it easy to use? Did our trainers give you the support you needed? We'd love to know if they helped you reach your fitness goals or answered your questions clearly.
Finally, what did you think about the cleanliness and atmosphere of the gym during your visit?
We appreciate your feedback!

The Fitness Club Team
